title: HDB rental shop vacancies and heartland retail diversity
asked: Ms Mariam Jaafar asked whether the Government has assessed how recent closures of small retail and F&B shops in the heartlands affect neighbourhood vibrancy, social cohesion and long-term community resilience, and what concrete measures are being taken to sustain local commercial diversity.
response: Ms Sun Xueling said HDB rental shop vacancy rates have remained low and stable over the past five years. She said some churn is healthy because it allows less competitive businesses to exit and new businesses to enter, providing products and services that can better meet residents' needs. HDB uses trade mix controls for HDB rental shops to ensure a good variety of shops, and when vacancies arise HDB assesses the trade designation and tenders them out as soon as possible.
